breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting instructions for defining the spatial grid. The incomplete prompt contained a preamble with a general rule for periodic domains (`dx=(b-a)/Nx`), a specific contradictory instruction (`dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)`), and a later instruction in the methods section that was correct (`dx=1/Nx`). The agent correctly discarded the contradictory preamble and only included the correct, unambiguous instruction: `dx = 1/Nx`. This matches the resolution in the ground truth.
